title: Crates tied with ropes
story: Stacks of plastic crates held only by six ropes, which CONTRAN 945/2022 allows only to hold a tarp.
story_pt: Pilhas de caixas plásticas presas só com seis cordas, que a Resolução CONTRAN 945/2022 só aceita para prender a lona.

violations.note: Load lashed only with ropes tied to the side hooks.

analysis.summary: A small flatbed truck carries tall stacks of empty plastic crates secured only with about six ropes over the top.
